p01.why: A closing parenthesis where the array bound needs a bracket is a token sequence that the grammar does not derive.

p02.why: main with C++ language linkage is valid by Q-0366 (Clang 22 and GCC 16 accept, EDG rejects), and it returns 0.

p03.why: The volatile writes are observable at -O2 as well, and the trace reaches 123.

p04.why: The class has size 2^64-1; only EDG (limit 2^64-1) accepts it, Clang 22 and GCC are over their limits, and Clang 18 gives sizeof a wrong value so the static_assert fails.

p05.why: A scoped enumeration head must have a name, so the grammar does not derive enum class with no identifier.

p06.why: f(0) reads through a null pointer during constant evaluation, which is undefined and so not constant.

p07.why: depth<N> needs depth<N+1> without end, so the chain goes past every depth limit.

p08.why: The declared return type of main must be int.

p09.why: Count<100> nests 100 instantiations of one template; Clang (1024) and GCC (900) accept, and EDG, which limits one template to 64, rejects.

p10.why: Division by zero in the constant evaluation of the static_assert is undefined, so the program is rejected.

p11.why: An array of 2^64-1 bytes: Clang (2^61-1) and GCC (2^63-1) reject it, and EDG (2^64-1) accepts it.

p12.why: An array of 2^63-1 bytes: GCC and EDG accept it, and Clang (limit 2^61-1) rejects it.

p13.why: Each of the 1000 volatile reads and writes happens at -O2, so port is 1000.

p14.why: The exception_decl production derives no default argument or initializer.

p15.why: The chain is 1000 deep: Clang (1024) accepts, GCC (900) rejects, and EDG rejects since each of Even and Odd nests 500 deep, past 64.

p16.why: for constexpr is not a form that the grammar derives.

p17.why: The division by zero is undefined even though its result is never used, so the constant evaluation fails.

p19.why: No variable with C language linkage in any namespace can be named main.

p20.why: Clang and GCC reject the unknown option, and EDG's limit of 10 is below the depth of 20.

p21.why: A function named main inside a namespace is an ordinary function; global main returns 1 - 1 = 0.

p22.why: A class of 2^61-1 bytes: Clang 22 (limit 2^60-1) rejects; Clang 18, GCC, and EDG accept with the right size.

p23.why: With -m32 the class has 0xffffffff bytes: GCC (2^31-1) rejects; Clang (no limit) and EDG ILP32 (2^32-1) accept.

p24.why: With -m32 an array of 2^31-1 bytes is within every limit; there is no main to run.

p25.why: With -m32 a class of 2^31 bytes: GCC rejects it, and Clang and EDG ILP32 accept it.

p26.why: Each unit has its own internal local, so 1 + 2 == 3.

p27.why: declared_only is used and defined nowhere, and the linkers report it.

p28.why: A class of 2^60-1 bytes is within every x86-64 limit.

p29.why: With -m32 a depth of 2000 exceeds Clang's 1024, GCC's 900, and EDG's 64.

p30.why: if consteval gives 1 in the static_assert and 2 at run time.

p31.why: Clang and GCC reject a depth of 50 under -ftemplate-depth=40, and EDG rejects the unknown option.

p32.why: The chain of function templates is 50 deep, under every limit including EDG's 64.

p34.why: The invalid initialization must be diagnosed even though never_called is never called.

p35.why: The exception_decl production derives no storage class.

p36.why: On x86-64 each float operation rounds to its type at translation and at run time, so the two sums match.

p38.why: A class of 2^61 bytes: GCC and EDG accept; Clang 22 rejects, and Clang 18 gives a wrong sizeof so the static_assert fails.

p39.why: later is constant-initialized to 2 before any dynamic initializer runs, so early reads 2.

p40.why: argc is at least 1 and argv[argc] is a null pointer.

p47.why: With -m32 a class of 2^31-1 bytes is within every limit.

p52.why: sq gives 9 in constant evaluation and at run time.
